snippet.title: Texas Cheat 'Em Gameplay
snippet.description:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/23510/
It's not whether you win or lose... it's about how far you can bend the rules without getting caught. In Texas Cheat 'Em, that's pretty darn far. Play casino-themed mini-games to activate one of 15 cheating abilities - then make your own luck. Turn a bad hand into a sure thing. Send your opponent's Royal Flush right down the drain. Steal chips, fold for free, or know the community cards in advance. Cheat strangers out of their fortunes... before they do it to you. Remember: glory is forever, but broke is only funny when it happens to someone else.
Forget those namby-pamby games that insist on fair play. Texas Cheat 'Em is a card-based party game that's all about winning - by any means necessary
Play fast-paced casino-themed games like Roulette, Blackjack, and Strength Test to activate your cheating abilities
Use one of 15 available cheats to give yourself an advantage. X-Ray Vision reveals an opponent's cards. Don't like the hand you've been dealt? Swap a better card out of the deck. Or forget the cards and steal another player's chips!
Play solo or trounce up to eight friends in a variety of online multiplayer modes
12 Steam Achievements, including "Sticky Fingers" for stealing another player's chips and "You Low Down, Dirty #@^%!" for winning a hand by using the "Guaranteed Win" Cheat
Includes 12 Steam Achievements
http://steamcommunity.com/stats/23510/achievements
Full Steamworks stats and leaderboards let you see how you stack up against the competition
